description: Add an emoji reaction to a Slack message as the Hermoso app, or take one away (remove:true). messageId is what post_to_slack or read_slack_channel gave ("<channel>/<ts>"). Read back from Slack. A workspace that added the app before 2026-11-15 adds it again once (the tool says so). Free.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in, for THIS CALL ONLY: an id or exact name from list_brands, needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

emoji.description: emoji name, like thumbsup, white_check_mark or tada
